name: alphabetical-function-cards
goal: Function cards sort by their displayed callable name by default and open through the code link without a duplicate arrow

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Default function ordering follows the callable name displayed in its code. Cards expose one code link, no arrow, and retain branch/commit navigation.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Shared collection tests ordered hidden titles, and viewport card cases required the duplicate arrow. Extend the same collection matrix with conflicting titles/callables and require one keyboard-reachable code link.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: 1481d2ab: isolated collection/rendering checks fail on hidden-title ordering and duplicate links; all three viewport checks fail with function cards have no arrow. Before images retained in /tmp/harness-alpha-before.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Function cards and sorting share the callable-name selector. Default A–Z and reverse order use that name; the single full-width code link replaces the arrow.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: 9cdd2300: the unchanged collection and card tests plus desktop/tablet/mobile grid scenarios pass in an isolated snapshot. Failing and passing commits and screenshots are preserved.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports workspace check passed: 595 unit tests, formatting, typecheck, lint, build and audit. All 30 related browser cases passed. Isolated unchanged regression: 15 unit cases and 3 viewport cases pass at 9cdd2300 after failing at 1481d2ab. Before/after screenshots in /tmp/harness-alpha-before and /tmp/harness-alpha-after inspected. Live list verified alphabetical across 524 cards with zero arrows; code-link navigation preserves branch context. Full root verification remains unresolved from prior work, so this global verification step stays pending. No native testing or main merge.
